NOT DONE, deliberately and worth knowing: Continue and Recent still render from the existing derivation, where lastUsedByItemId and pinnedItemIds are hard-coded five-entry literals for demo slugs and real registry items fall back to the literal string 'Saved'. Direction B leads with both surfaces, so they want a genuine per-item last-opened timestamp; that is a data-layer change and building it here would have silently rescoped this row. Captured as its own row.
